about: ADR-0221 and ADR-0232 — the seven measures of code health. A RATCHET, never a score: `tests/code-health.node.test.js` refuses a module that got worse and a new module above the ceiling. Rewrite this file only when a debt is PAID, a module is legitimately split, or the growth BUYS something no measure here can see — and in that third case the commit has to name the purchase and the falsifiable criterion that will show it landed (ADR-0221 point 6: the criterion is the co-change falling, not the number). Rewriting it to green a red build is the ratchet being unscrewed. `stateful` is the set of modules that hold state or reach a browser global (ADR-0232 point 4), written BY NAME so that a module entering or leaving it is a line a reviewer reads.
